summary: Resolves a code-page identifier to an actual Windows code page. Identifier 0xFFFFFFFE maps to the OEM code page via GetOEMCP, 0xFFFFFFFD maps to the ANSI code page via GetACP, and 0xFFFFFFFC maps to the stored default CodePage global. The global auto-flag dword_8D41D4 is cleared first and set to 1 whenever a special identifier is resolved; any other identifier passes through unchanged with the flag left at 0. Invoked from sub_596E40.

local_names.a1: code-page identifier (negative sentinel values or a passthrough value)
local_names.result: resolved code page, or the unchanged input identifier
local_names.dword_8D41D4: global auto-select flag, set to 1 on any special identifier

operations.description: Initialize result = a1 so a non-matching identifier passes through unchanged.
Clear the global auto-flag dword_8D41D4 = 0 before dispatching on the identifier.
Case 0xFFFFFFFE (OEM): set dword_8D41D4 = 1 and return the result of GetOEMCP().
Case 0xFFFFFFFD (ANSI): set dword_8D41D4 = 1 and return the result of GetACP().
Case 0xFFFFFFFC (default): read result = CodePage (the stored default code page) and set dword_8D41D4 = 1.
Return result: the resolved code page for a special identifier, otherwise the unchanged input.
